visual_brief: 达雷尔·K·罗亚尔-得克萨斯纪念体育场（奥斯汀，UT）：U 形/封闭大碗，焦橙色（burnt orange）人潮，两端区写 TEXAS，中场长角牛 logo，北端巨型 Godzillatron 大屏，背景可见 UT Tower 或奥斯汀天际线。经典视角：高处俯瞰满场或航拍校园+球场。易混：达拉斯 Cotton Bowl（UT vs OU 红河之战在那里打）、其他橙色主题球场。
notes: 无合格可商用照片，建议出图。Flickr 检索 darrell k royal texas memorial stadium、texas memorial stadium、DKR stadium austin / DKR、longhorns stadium austin、texas longhorns football stadium / game、UT austin stadium aerial、austin texas aerial stadium、memorial stadium austin 等。没有可商用航拍；满场图都是看台观众视角：c2（Todd Dwyer，CC BY-SA 2.0，2048×1530，Flickr 原图被限流只拿到 2048 版）满场+两端 TEXAS 端区+乐队，但下方约 35% 是前排观众后脑，裁掉后只剩约 950 px 高，不够 1000；c1（BryanKemp，CC BY 2.0，2048×1536）开赛前看台半空、前景有观众头，试裁后半空看台很明显，已放弃；c3 为夜间高速公路光轨远望 UT Tower，球场很小。已删除误入的 Cotton Bowl 红河之战图。理想画面：Elevated view of Darrell K Royal–Texas Memorial Stadium in Austin on a sunny game day: the huge bowl completely packed with fans in burnt orange, 'TEXAS' painted in both end zones and the white Longhorn logo at midfield, the giant video board at the north end, the UT Tower and downtown Austin skyline visible beyond the rim, clear blue sky; avoid spectators' heads in the foreground and avoid the Cotton Bowl in Dallas.
